description.value: Jinmi is a Korean soul food restaurant on Cambie Street in Vancouver, specializing in fresh, authentic Korean cuisine including their signature marinated crab. The restaurant operates on a fully reservation-based model with all bookings made through their website. It positions itself as an experiential dining destination rather than a casual drop-in eatery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the OSM address (782 Cambie St, Vancouver, BC V6B 2R5), phone (604 564 8800), and reservation-only model. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, Wi-Fi, takeout, or any cycling-specific amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags. The website footer shows '© 2035 Jinmi' which is a likely Wix template artifact, not a real date.
concerns: Website footer displays '© 2035 Jinmi' — likely a Wix template artifact with an incorrect year, but worth noting.
Reservation-only model (confirmed by both OSM tag reservation=required and website) significantly limits utility for unplanned touring cyclist visits.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: None of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. Additionally, the reservation-only model makes spontaneous drop-in access by touring cyclists unlikely.
